items.title: Iran's Army Navy claims a 'violating' oil tanker caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: The Iranian Army Navy (Nedaja) announced Tuesday morning via state news agency IRNA that an oil tanker described as 'violating' caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz. No details were given on the nature of the violation, the vessel's identity, damage extent, or crew casualties. This is a separate claim from the IRGC Navy's Oct 10-12 mine-strike claims: it comes from the regular Army Navy and places the incident east of the strait (i.e., in the Gulf of Oman approach), which would extend Iran's claimed enforcement zone beyond the strait if it reflects a new event. Tasnim published boat-shot footage of a burning tanker alongside the claim. No independent confirmation; treat as an Iranian-state claim.
